generic_name: Drospirenone, Ethinyl Estradiol, and Levomefolate Calcium
drug_class: Combination Oral Contraceptive with Folate Supplement
purpose: This pill is used to prevent pregnancy. It also helps treat moderate acne and symptoms of premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD), which is a severe form of PMS. The added folate (a B vitamin) helps reduce the risk of certain birth defects if you happen to become pregnant.
how_it_works: This medication contains two hormones — estrogen and progestin — that work together to stop your ovaries from releasing an egg each month. It also thickens the mucus in your cervix so sperm have a harder time getting through, and it changes the lining of your uterus to make it less likely for a fertilized egg to attach. The folate component is simply a B vitamin that supports healthy cell growth.
common_side_effects: Some common side effects include nausea, headaches, breast tenderness or swelling, spotting or light bleeding between periods, mood changes, and decreased sex drive. These often get better after the first few months of use.
warnings: This medication is not recommended if you smoke, especially if you are over 35, because it raises the risk of serious blood clots, stroke, or heart attack. Do not take it if you have a history of blood clots, certain heart conditions, liver problems, or uncontrolled high blood pressure. It can also raise potassium levels in your blood, so your doctor may want to check a blood test. Always tell your doctor about all other medications you take, as some can make this pill less effective.
typical_dosing: You take one pill by mouth every day at the same time each day. The pack contains 24 active hormone pills followed by 4 reminder pills that contain only folate. Try to take it at the same time every day to keep it working its best and to help you remember.
